acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:4de4ad06-.title: Business Development Representative
acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:4de4ad06-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Vanta is growing quickly, we're profitable, and we're continually outpacing our growth targets while maintaining very strong NPS scores. Needless to say, it's an exciting time! We're scaling our Sales Development team with customer-focused SDRs who will take ownership of our outbound sales engine and help to build pipeline as we move up market, and distinguish Vanta as best-in-class to prospects in a burgeoning competitive landscape. If this sounds like you, and you're excited to join a growing team, we'd love to hear from you. What you’ll do as a Business Development Representative at Vanta: - Have a strong understanding of Vanta’s value proposition and product - Master the process of identifying strategic accounts using tools like Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Outreach, Linkedin Sales Nav, and 6Sense, that will help us move up market - Organize a multi-channel approach to prospecting and and maximize efforts by developing sequences in Outreach - Coordinate meetings on account executive’s calendars and log activities - Efficiently and gracefully counter objections, as well as have excellent interpersonal & technical skills How to be successful in this role: - Have prior experience in B2B SaaS, preferably in a pipeline-generating Sales role - Help us to manage our current Outbound Engine - Be a self-starter who enjoys creating process and procedures for a scaling business - Be highly empathetic to prospects as a strong brand representative for Vanta - Have stellar problem solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up - Be able to commute to come in office hybrid 3 days per week - College degree required What you can expect as a Vantan: - Industry-competitive salary and equity - 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage - 16 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents (birthing, non-birthing, and adoptive) - Health & wellness stipend - Remote workspace stipend - Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office - Pension matching - 25 days of PTO per year and unlimited sick time - 8 company paid holidays - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! #LI-hybrid At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent. Referral Instructions If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

bloom-bloom:lever:9901ce9c-47ab-44d4-9e9.title: Director of Ecommerce | Poppy & Peonies
bloom-bloom:lever:9901ce9c-47ab-44d4-9e9.description: Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a Director of Ecommerce to join their dynamic team. As Talent Advisors, we serve as the bridge between our Bloom Partner and you throughout the recruitment process. At Bloom, we don’t rely on automated tools to sift through applications—every resume is carefully reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. If selected, you’ll join Poppy & Peonies directly as a valued member of their team. We’re excited to consider your application! Please note that applications will be accepted throughout the holiday season. Thank you for your patience and interest in this opportunity! Hi, I’m Natalie Dusome, Founder and CEO of Poppy & Peonies, a fun and energetic brand that believes styles and function should co-exist. We’re passionate about creating practical pieces that help make life a little easier and lighten the load, literally. Building Poppy & Peonies has been a wild adventure. The journey began when my daughter Poppy was born and my accessories no longer worked with my new life as a mom, I needed bags with pockets and organization that looked cool and had functionality. I couldn’t find it, so I decided to create it, and in 2015 Poppy & Peonies was born. We’ve come a long way in five years – from filling orders in my basement to appearing on Dragons’ Den, and now, expanding into new product categories and collaborating with some exciting influencers and brands. I’d be lying if I said it’s been nothing but smooth sailing, but thanks to our incredible community, we’ve never felt more loved and supported! We believe in our responsibility to care for our environment and we are passionate about preserving the health and welfare of our planet, and the animals that live on it. All of our bags are made from high-quality vegan leather, and our entire product line is vegan, cruelty-free, and PETA-approved. We ship our products plastic-free and we use a combination of recycled, compostable, and biodegradable materials to mitigate shipping waste, and we are constantly looking for new ways to make our products and supply chain more sustainable to reduce our carbon footprint. About the Role Poppy & Peonies is looking for a digitally-savvy, customer-obsessed Director of Ecommerce to own and evolve our DTC site experience. This is a high-ownership role where you'll set the direction across site merchandising, conversion, platform management, and UX with the trust and autonomy to make real decisions. You'll start by managing a freelance developer and an e-commerce manager, with a clear path to build the team around you as the business scales. If you're energized by the intersection of beautiful products and sharp digital execution, this is the role for you.

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:47.title: Operations Manager - Stone / Marble Fabrication
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:47.description: Our client is a trusted and established manufacturer of custom cultured marble fixtures, serving the St. Louis metropolitan area since 1978. Known for its commitment to quality craftsmanship and customer satisfaction, the company offers a wide range of products, including countertops, vanities, and shower bases, all fabricated in-house from high-quality materials. With a focus on innovation and design, our client is looking to hire an experienced and results-driven Operations Manager to lead day-to-day operations and drive efficiency and organizational growth.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:3bf.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Sales Associateat Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the retail store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. In this role, you’ll support daily operations, deliver a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, and help drive sales by sharing product knowledge. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Actively engage customers, identify their needs, recommend relevant products or experiences, and leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture Sales & Business Performance · Maximize selling opportunities by identifying customer needs and offering relevant solutions. · Promote add-on sales and support events that grow store traffic and customer engagement. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. While this is the minimum availability, scheduled hours may differ based on business needs. · Regular and predictable attendance Qualifications & Experience · Must be 18 years of age or older at the time of employment. · 1 year of retail sales experience preferred. · Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. · Passion for community engagement and providing exceptional customer experiences. · Proficiency in Microsoft Office and retail management syst

jobgether-jobgether:lever:25bf4955-ddaa-.title: Senior Accounts Receivable & Revenue Operations Specialist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:25bf4955-ddaa-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Accounts Receivable & Revenue Operations Specialist based in Australia. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical revenue operations within a fast-paced, remote startup environment. You will manage the revenue cycle end-to-end, ensuring accuracy and efficiency from quoting through collections. The position combines accounts receivable expertise with systems optimization, reporting, automation, and process improvement. You will work closely with accounting, sales, and customers to resolve billing issues and maintain strong financial operations. Your ability to identify discrepancies, improve workflows, and strengthen financial controls will directly support business growth. The role is ideal for a proactive finance professional who enjoys autonomy, problem-solving, and evolving priorities. You will have the opportunity to contribute to scalable processes while working with modern accounting and payment technologies. Lead end-to-end revenue operations, covering quote generation, invoicing, reconciliation, receivables tracking, and timely collections. Review invoices and billing information against order forms, investigate discrepancies, and coordinate resolutions with sales teams and customers. Respond to customer and sales inquiries regarding invoices, billing issues, and payment status while taking ownership of the collections process. Support accurate revenue reporting by collaborating with accounting teams and reviewing SQL query outputs for accuracy and consistency. Manage and optimize financial systems such as QuickBooks Online and Stripe, including system upgrades, automation initiatives, and workflow improvements. Identify opportunities to streamline revenue processes, strengthen operational controls, and improve the overall quote-to-cash cycle. Communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal stakeholders regarding billing, collections, and financial matters. Work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with accounting, sales, and other operational teams. Requirements 2+ years of accounting experience within U.S.-based companies, with a strong focus on Accounts Receivable and Revenue Operations. Demonstrated experience managing the complete revenue cycle from quote to cash. Advanced proficiency with QuickBooks Online and Stripe, with the ability to review SQL query outputs and identify potential inaccuracies. Strong reconciliation and problem-solving skills, including the confidence to challenge discrepancies and push back appropriately with customers or sales teams. Experience implementing process improvements, system upgrades, and automation projects within accounting or revenue operations. Familiarity with startup accounting environments and the ability to adapt effectively to changing priorities. Experience with tools such as Slack, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Mercury, Chase, Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, or ClickUp is a plus. Professional fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and trustworthy, with a strong sense of ownership and integrity. Comfortable working independently while also contributing effectively within a collaborative team. Coachable and eager to continuously improve processes, systems, and professional capabilities. General awareness of how AI is being applied to accounting and operational workflows is an advantage. Benefits Competitive salary paid in USD per month, based on experience. Unlimited paid vacation days per year. All U.S. national holidays included. Fully remote opportunity with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world. Opportunity to work in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving priorities. Professional growth and learning opportunities. Supportive and collaborative working environment. jobgether-jobgether:lever:39609400-f724-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer based in the United States. This is a high-impact engineering role at the intersection of software development, AI automation, and real-world business operations. You will work directly with client teams to understand complex workflows and identify opportunities where technology can deliver measurable value. The role combines hands-on production engineering with customer-facing discovery, requiring you to move comfortably between code and operational conversations. You will build AI agents, integrations, and automated workflows that solve specific business challenges and perform reliably in production. You’ll work with enterprise systems such as TMS, WMS, and ERP platforms while continuously refining AI behavior based on real-world data and edge cases. The role offers significant autonomy in a fast-moving, growth-stage environment where speed, pragmatism, and ownership are highly valued. What you learn from customer engagements will also help shape reusable platform capabilities and influence the broader product and engineering strategy. Shadow client teams and conduct structured discovery to understand operational workflows, identify pain points, and prioritize the problems with the greatest potential impact. Design solutions tailored to specific business needs, selecting the right combination of automation, AI agents, integrations, or other technologies before moving into development. Build, deploy, and maintain production solutions integrating with transportation management systems, warehouse management systems, enterprise resource planning platforms, and other third-party systems. Prototype and rapidly ship AI-powered automation, including shipment tracking, automated check calls, carrier qualification and onboarding, and voice- or chat-based agents. Tune prompts, agent behavior, voice models, and transcription systems using production data, continuously improving performance as new edge cases emerge. Identify security, compliance, and infrastructure requirements early and coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve potential blockers. Troubleshoot issues directly in customer environments, adapting or re-scoping solutions when circumstances change and maintaining momentum toward business outcomes. Share insights from customer implementations with product and engineering teams, transforming recurring needs and patterns into scalable platform capabilities rather than one-off solutions. Requirements: 5+ years of full-stack software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Python and TypeScript and the associated libraries and frameworks used for rapid development. Hands-on experience designing and implementing automated workflows and AI-driven solutions that improve or optimize business processes. Proven experience developing, maintaining, and integrating APIs with third-party or enterprise systems. Strong ability to work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translating operational requirements into practical technical solutions and communicating trade-offs clearly. Comfortable operating independently in ambiguous situations, including debugging production issues, improvising solutions, and making sound technical decisions in customer-facing environments. Demonstrated ability to ship functional software quickly in fast-changing, growth-oriented environments. Strong problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and ownership skills, with a pragmatic approach focused on delivering measurable results. Experience with voice or transcription-based systems, particularly in operational environments, is a plus. Familiarity with freight, transportation, or supply chain technologies such as TMS, WMS, or ERP platforms is preferred. Experience in a startup or growth-stage environment where the underlying platform is still evolving is advantageous. Exposure to LLM

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5a9821a9-4ff4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Engineer (Full Stack) based in India. This is a senior-level engineering opportunity focused on building reliable integrations and data products that connect a fundraising platform with the systems nonprofits depend on. You’ll operate as a problem solver, taking ownership of ambiguous challenges from discovery through implementation and long-term maintenance. The role combines backend and frontend engineering with API design, data movement, observability, and third-party integrations. You’ll work extensively with Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and modern web technologies. Your work will directly influence data integrity, customer experience, and the reliability of critical integrations at scale. You’ll join a fully remote, globally distributed team with a flat structure and a strong emphasis on pragmatic, maintainable engineering. The environment encourages autonomy, thoughtful technical decisions, collaboration, and shipping meaningful improvements without unnecessary process. Own integrations end to end: Build, operate, and continuously improve CRM and large-scale data synchronization integrations, treating them as long-lived products rather than one-time projects. Ensure reliable data movement: Design systems that safely transfer records between platforms while handling deduplication, partial failures, retries, idempotency, and interrupted processing. Build observability into integrations: Develop monitoring, logging, error reporting, and diagnostic capabilities that make synchronization issues visible and actionable before they affect customers. Design durable APIs and webhooks: Create thoughtful data models and public-facing interfaces, with careful consideration for versioning, pagination, naming conventions, and error handling. Apply strong product judgment: Evaluate requirements through a customer-focused lens, challenge unnecessary complexity, and help prioritize engineering work based on customer value, feasibility, and impact. Collaborate and deliver: Work closely with engineering, product, and support teams, contribute to code reviews, help resolve technical escalations, and balance delivery speed with long-term quality. Maintain engineering knowledge: Keep developer documentation, internal guides, and technical references accurate and useful, particularly where historical architectural decisions affect current integrations. Drive ambiguous problems to resolution: Determine what work is required to solve complex problems, make informed trade-offs, and take ownership through completion without relying on highly detailed specifications. Requirements Strong experience designing, building, and consuming REST APIs , including practical judgment around versioning, pagination, and error semantics. Demonstrated experience integrating with third-party systems you do not control , including handling rate limits, retries, partial failures, idempotency, and webhook delivery. Proven ability to move data between systems with different or incompatible data models, including record mapping, deduplication, and reconciliation. Strong proficiency with Ruby and Ruby on Rails , including designing data models and Rails objects for medium-sized features. Solid PostgreSQL and SQL skills, including the ability to write complex operational and bulk queries and interpret PostgreSQL EXPLAIN output. Experience writing robust automated tests that validate application behavior rather than implementation details; familiarity with Minitest is preferred. Strong independent problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to take ambiguous requirements, identify the underlying work, and deliver practical solutions.
